title: Strategies For Concentrated Stock Wealth
description: This lively webinar features three seasoned financial planners explaining strategies and tips for reducing concentration risk and getting clients to take the necessary actions. Advising clients on billions of dollars of public and private company stock, these advisors guide employees, executives, and founders through every company growth stage and with all types of equity comp. This webinar goes beyond explaining the tax and financial-planning strategies to focus on helping clients take action. Learn practical ways to get your clients, with advisor guidance, to feel comfortable in making informed decisions to build their wealth and prevent mistakes.
learningObjectives: Overview of concentrated stock strategies: 10b5-1 plans, gifting, CRTs, net vs. cash exercise, hedging
Tax-aware strategies, including RSU planning, option exercise approaches, AMT management, 83(b) elections
The execution gap: why clients don't act
Common behavior blockages: fear, FOMO, overconfidence, inertia, optimism bias
Behavioral frameworks for action and life-planning in equity decision conversations
Nudges, not just numbers, to encourage client action
Sample advisor scripts for reducing anxiety and guiding action
Client case studies illustrating key concepts
